description: Create a draft message in the Drafts folder without sending it. Returns the created draft, which can be reviewed and sent from Outlook. It does not ask to confirm: a draft reaches nobody until it is sent from Outlook. Calling it twice leaves two drafts. If Outlook does not answer in time, the connection drops, or a server error (5xx) comes back after the request was sent, the result has status "unknown": the write may well have gone through, so check before retrying — never resend blindly.

html.description: Compose the body as HTML (default: plain text)

name: outlook_create_draft
